# QR Code Generator & Reader

> A lightweight static tool for generating QR codes from exact text and
> decoding QR codes from local images.

## Product

- Text and images are processed in the browser and are not uploaded.
- Japanese and English interfaces provide equivalent behavior.
- Generated QR codes can be downloaded as PNG files.
- Decoded payloads are rendered as untrusted text and can be copied exactly.
- The initial page load fetches integrity-checked QR libraries from jsDelivr.

## Documentation

- [Project README](./README.md): Features, usage, local-processing boundaries,
  project structure, and contract-test instructions.
- [Product contract](./PRODUCT.md): Users, product purpose, design principles,
  and accessibility requirements.
